responsibility: This file defines the pipeline scheduler model for the Loongson 2E and 2F cores. In addition to integer, floating-point, and memory reservations, it models the cores’ round-robin ALU and FALU dispatch strategy using query units, pseudo turn-tracking units, special UNSPEC helper insns, and a custom ls2_turn_type attribute that scheduler hooks in mips.cc use to maintain dispatch state, making it the most specialized scheduling description in the module for loongson_2e/2f tuning.
